description: 该接口为采购单生成发货单履约的场景调用。详细履约介绍请查看备货单履约管理文档。

children.name: Content-Type
children.description: 默认值：application/json

children.name: x-lt-openKeyId
children.description: 访问用户隐私数据时的唯一权限标识 openKeyId

children.name: x-lt-timestamp
children.description: 请求时间戳，格式为时间转换为毫秒的值，也就是从1970年1月1日起至今的时间转换为毫秒，如：1583398764000

children.name: x-lt-signature
children.description: 接口签名

children.name: x-lt-language
children.description: 指定出参语种，默认中文；支持语种:英语:US 法语:FR 西班牙语:ES 德语:DE 中文简体:CN 泰语:TH 巴西葡语:PT 土耳其语：TR

children.name: adminName
children.description: 用户名称（ERP系统可自行定义，用于系统记录此次发货的操作人，页面不展示）

children.name: agedProductCode
children.description: 时效产品编码，从物流产品查询接口获取

children.name: skuCode
children.description: sku编码，需要入参采购单中所有的SKU

children.name: orderNo
children.description: 订单编号

children.name: orderQuantity
children.description: 下单数量

children.name: packageNum
children.description: 包裹数（箱唛发货时必填，同一订单传相同包裹数）

children.name: tempDeliveryQuantity
children.description: 实际发货数量：如果待发货数量大于500，单次发货需要大于150

children.name: packingInfoList
children.description: 装箱明细，当shippingRoute为1时需要传入装箱明细

children.name: packQuantity
children.description: 装箱数量

children.name: skuCode
children.description: 装箱的sku编码

children.name: orderType
children.description: 订单类型，1：急采，2：备货

children.name: deliveryType
children.description: 发货方式，商家可用的发货方式枚举值请从发货基本信息查询获取；

children.name: arrivalTime
children.description: 预约SEHIN到仓时间（yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss），当deliveryType=4或21时必填

children.name: shippingRoute
children.description: 发货路径，0：无发货路径，1：直送路径，2：集货路径

children.name: expressId
children.description: 快递编码，SHEIN集成物流场景从物流产品查询接口companyCode字段获取，非SHIEN集成物流场景从发货基本信息查询接口companyCode获取，当deliveryType=1时必填

children.name: coding
children.description: 车队编码，当deliveryType=2且使用车队自送场景必填

children.name: expressInfo
children.description: 运单包裹信息

children.name: addrId
children.description: 发货地址id，从发货基本信息查询接口中获取

children.name: expressCode
children.description: 快递单号，适用非SHIEN集成物流场景

children.name: packageNumber
children.description: 总包裹数量（箱唛类型时=所有订单包裹的总计）

children.name: packageWeight
children.description: 包裹重量（单位:kg）

children.name: reserveParcelTime
children.description: 预约取货时间（yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss），当使用SHEIN集成物流或SHEIN集成车队送货时必填

children.name: deliveryPackages
children.description: 包裹信息列表,包裹列表的长度必须与包裹数量相同

children.name: index
children.description: 包裹序号，从0开始

children.name: packageHeight
children.description: 包裹高(cm)

children.name: packageLength
children.description: 包裹长(cm)

children.name: packageWeight
children.description: 包裹重量(kg)

children.name: packageWidth
children.description: 包裹宽(cm)

children.name: supplierWarehouseId
children.description: 商家仓库id

children.name: subWarehouseId
children.description: 供应商子仓ID

children.name: thirdPartyChannel
children.description: 货代渠道

children.name: thirdPartyChannelName
children.description: 货代渠道名称

children.name: thirdPartyOrderMethod
children.description: 货代下单方式：1：SHEIN代下单2：商家自行下单

children.name: code
children.description: 响应编码 成功：0

children.name: deliveryCode
children.description: 发货单号

children.name: expressCode
children.description: 运单号（系统自动产生运单时，返回运单号）
children.label: 运单号

children.name: msg
children.description: 错误描述，成功：OK；支持指定语种出参；

children.name: traceId
children.description: 请求的唯一标识，用于异常报错跟踪

responseExample: code": "0032001", "msg": "B231107500397订单状态不能发货", "info": null, "bbl": null }
